summary.core_truth: Core runtime, Superbrain Beta/GA, E2E flows, and final build gates are green; final release remains PARTIAL only because security rotation acknowledgements are still open.

completed_closures.title: Local core stack health and compose contract

gaps.title: External OllamaHfTrae dispatch endpoints timeout under real dispatch load
gaps.warum_offen: Resolved: after probe-payload hardening, two consecutive Superbrain gate runs show 3/3 successful probes with HTTP 200.
gaps.fix_strategy: Keep lightweight authenticated probe payload to measure endpoint health without long generation latency.
closure_proof_required: at least one dispatch artifact per external.* agent with status=forwarded and no dry_run
gaps.user_impact: External branches are currently usable in the validated runtime profile.

gaps.fix_strategy: No further action for this gap; keep regression gate in CI/runtime checks.
closure_proof_required: final_build_artifact_manifest.json + final_build_screenshot.png unchanged as proof bundle
gaps.user_impact: Build closure is now proven with full artifact bundle.

gaps.title: Release freeze cleanliness not achieved
gaps.warum_offen: Resolved: release-freeze was re-established on current main by committing the fresh verification artifacts and protocol sync, then pushing to origin/main.
gaps.fix_strategy: Keep freeze discipline: run gates, sync docs/evidence, commit once, and push before marking freeze as clean.
closure_proof_required: git status clean (or documented intentional exceptions)
commit SHA referencing updated evidence and docs
gaps.user_impact: Operator can compare runtime claims against a frozen commit baseline again.

no contradictory 100% closure claims against latest JSON evidence
